notes: Topic spelling variants that point at one canonical slug. Reviewed list: `groups`; the code reads `merges` only.
A talk tagged with a variant counts as tagged with the canonical topic (tags are de-duplicated per talk), and /topics/<variant> answers 301 to /topics/<canonical>.

Rules: hyphen-variant (lock-picking / lockpicking), singular-plural, stemmer-artifact (the slug is a truncated word such as kubernete or analysi; judged by how often each form is a real word in titles and summaries), event-name-spelling, verb-form (red-teaming -> red-team).
Only groups where both the variant and the canonical topic have at least 3 talks are listed (the topics that are indexable today). Thinner variants stay as they are and remain noindex.

Kept apart on purpose: http/https, arm/arms, day/days, matter/matters, lock/locks, adjective and noun pairs (economic/economics, robotic/robotics, electronic/electronics), and person-name pairs that are different people (adam/adams, harri/harris).
`eventNameTags` are tags that name an event or a session kind rather than a subject. Their spelling variants are merged like any other; none is dropped or noindexed here.
